blocks.text: What Scamwatch says about fake rental and share-house listings.
SAVE IT FOR YOUR NEXT MOVE

items.text: They have an excuse for why you can't see the place
The room may exist, but belong to someone else
*Never pay* for a rental you cannot inspect

blocks.text: Source: Scamwatch (scamwatch.gov.au), buying and selling scams. Checked 17 Nov 2026.

items.text: Asked for a bond or rent in advance, before you've seen it
Odd ways to pay: money order, pre-loaded card, several different PayIDs

blocks.text: Scamwatch: it is rare to recover money sent by money transfer.
Source: Scamwatch (buying and selling scams; rental listing alerts). Checked 17 Nov 2026.

items.text: Asked to send your passport or licence before you've seen the room
Extremely low rent, made to grab your attention
Inspect it in person. A drive-by is not enough
Using an agent? Check they're licensed in your state
Search the address, the name and the email online
Keep the listing, the messages and the payment details

blocks.text: Already paid? Contact your bank immediately, then report it to Scamwatch.
Sources: Scamwatch; ACCC (21 Sep 2020). Checked 17 Nov 2026.
